extensionDescription.message: Selectively clear site data for a specific origin

useCurrentTabShort.description: Short label of the use-current-tab button.

scopeExact.message: Only this origin. Other origins are not touched.
scopeExact.description: Scope note when cleanup is limited to the exact origin.

scopeWide.message: Cookies apply to the whole registrable domain, so related subdomains may be signed out.
scopeWide.description: Scope note when cookies are selected.

dataToClearLabel.description: Heading of the data type selection.

cookieScopeTag.description: Tag next to Cookies indicating registrable-domain scope.

confirmDataLabel.description: Confirmation label for selected data types.

confirmUntouchedLabel.description: Confirmation label for data that stays.

confirmUntouchedOrigins.message: Site storage of every other origin

confirmUntouchedBrowser.message: History, downloads, form data and passwords

confirmCookieNotice.message: Cookies are removed for the whole registrable domain, including related subdomains.
confirmCookieNotice.description: Cookie scope notice in the confirmation panel.

errorUnsupportedScheme.message: This page uses an unsupported scheme. Navigate to an HTTP(S) page.

errorSelectDataType.message: Please select at least one data type.

presetLogout.description: Name of the built-in preset that ends the login session for the target origin.

presetLogoutDesc.message: Removes this site's cookies and session storage, then reloads the tab.
presetLogoutDesc.description: Description of the Log out preset.

presetFresh.description: Name of the built-in preset that resets the site's stored state.

presetFreshDesc.message: Clears cookies and site storage for this origin, then opens its start page. The HTTP cache is kept.
presetFreshDesc.description: Description of the Fresh start preset.

presetStale.description: Name of the built-in preset that clears cached files and service workers.

presetStaleDesc.message: Clears the HTTP cache, Cache Storage and service workers, then reloads without cache. Logins stay.
presetStaleDesc.description: Description of the Fix stale files preset.

presetFull.description: Name of the built-in preset that selects every supported data type for the target origin only.

presetFullDesc.message: Selects every supported data type, for this origin only, then reloads without cache.

presetCustom.description: Label shown when the current selection no longer matches any preset.
